json.content: then there was forty or fifty people in the house every night, my mother in the front room with her rosary, Remy doing the dishes she wasnt asked to do, and me in the kitchen doing the sinigang and the lumpia and somebody always needing another plate. Dan was out front with the uncles, doing the ice and the chairs. everybody had a job. and when it was over and the last ones left, the house was so quiet I could hear the fridge. I sat down on the kitchen floor in my church shoes
